title: db-selection-adr template variables
description: Values for templates/db-selection-adr.md.j2 and templates/db-selection-adr.html.j2. Generated by tpl-jinja from db-selection-adr.md; `description` on each property is the question put to the author.

access_pattern.title: Access pattern
access_pattern.description: The read/write shape this must serve - query patterns, hot keys, consistency requirement, peak QPS, dataset size and growth. Numbers you measured or projected. "High scale" is not an access pattern.

bounded_context.title: Bounded context
bounded_context.description: The one bounded context this database serves, kebab-case - "checkout", "search-index". One decision per context; if you cannot name a single one, the decision is drawn too wide to defend.

chosen_db.title: Chosen db
chosen_db.description: Product and major version you are committing to - "PostgreSQL 16". Give the version - the feature you are counting on may not exist in the one ops actually installs.

date.title: Date
date.description: The day this was agreed, ISO - not the day it was typed up. Downstream reviews are scheduled off it, so a placeholder date silently disables the review.

email.title: Email
email.description: The owner's email, reachable after they change teams. This is the address the next engineer writes to before undoing what this document decided.

owner.title: Owner
owner.description: The person accountable for this choice - whoever gets paged when the storage engine turns out to be the reason. A team alias here means the page has no destination.

reversibility.title: Reversibility
reversibility.description: How hard is leaving? partial_two_way = dual-write then migrate. one_way_door_costly = months of work and a data rewrite. one_way_door_irrevocable = the old model cannot be reconstructed.

rollback_cost.title: Rollback cost
rollback_cost.description: What leaving would actually cost - engineering weeks, contract exit fees, customer-visible downtime. Estimate it now, while nobody is angry and the estimate is still honest.
